info.name: Authentication & Profile APIs
info.description: Complete API Collection for DailyOS Authentication and User Profile Management modules.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Authentication module endpoints: register, login, Google sign-in, refresh token, logout, email verification, password management, and active session management.

request.description: Register a new user using email and password. Normalizes email and hashes password with Argon2id.

response.name: 201 Created

request.description: Authenticate user with email and password. Returns access token and rotating refresh token, and sets secure HTTP-only refresh cookie.
Authenticates user via verified Google ID token. Finds or creates the user and auth account securely.
Validates existing refresh token, rotates tokens, revokes the previous session, and returns new credentials.
Revokes the current session and clears HTTP-only refresh cookies without affecting other devices.
Revokes all active sessions across all devices for the authenticated user.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Verifies email address using the single-use verification token sent to user.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Requests a password reset link. Returns an identical success message even if the email does not exist to prevent account enumeration.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Validates reset token, updates password with Argon2id, and revokes all active sessions.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Returns basic account and profile info for the currently authenticated user.
Allows an authenticated user to update their password after verifying their current password.
Returns all active login sessions and device details for the authenticated user.

variable.description: The UUID of the session to revoke

request.description: Revokes a specific active session belonging to the user.

item.name: Profile
item.description: Profile module endpoints: personal profile, health profile, body measurements, professional profile, lifestyle profile, personal goals, and complete unified profile.
